name: Name Capture
description: Asks for the user's name and moves on only once Pass 1 has extracted it

ask_name.extraction_instructions: Extract the user's first name as 'user_name'. Leave it empty if the user has not said their name.
ask_name.response_instructions: Ask the user for their first name.

welcome.purpose: Greet the user by name and end the conversation
welcome.response_instructions: Welcome the user by their name and say goodbye.
